title: 관리실에서: 도어락이 안 열려요
objective: Explain a door lock problem by giving background first with -는데.
summary: Tell your apartment management office that your door lock is broken.
setting: The management office (관리실) of an apartment building. A resident can't get in because the door lock won't open, so they ask the staff for help.

task.title: Explain the door lock problem
task.line: Choose, fill in, connect, or reorder the Korean words, and use -는데 to give the background first.

words.exampleMeaning: I want to change my door lock code.

words.meaning: code (number you press to open a lock)
to open (by itself; the door/window opens)
to break down, to stop working
words.exampleMeaning: The elevator is out of order.
I changed the remote control's batteries.

words.meaning: to make a sound (a machine beeps or makes noise)
words.exampleMeaning: The fridge is making a strange noise.

dialogue.meaning: Hello. How can I help you?

dialogue.korean: 저는 101동 1203호에 사는데 도어락이 고장 난 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: I live in Building 101, Unit 1203, and I think my door lock is broken.
I pressed the code, but the door won't open.
Then I think the battery is dead.

dialogue.korean: 지금 집에 못 들어가는데 어떻게 해요?
dialogue.meaning: I can't get into my home right now. What should I do?

dialogue.korean: 기사님을 불러 드릴게요. 여기서 잠깐 기다리세요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll call a repair technician for you. Please wait here for a moment.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 배터리가 없어서 문이 안 (열려요 / 눌러요). ② 밤에 도어락에서 이상한 소리가 (나요 / 열려요).
Fill in the blank with the past tense + -는데 form of 바꾸다: 어제 비밀번호를 ____ 기억이 안 나요.
Join the two sentences with -는데: ① 저는 205호에 살아요. + 도어락에서 계속 소리가 나요. ② 지금 밖에 있어요. + 문을 열 수 없어요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 안 와요 / 한 시간 / 기다렸는데 / 기사님이
Answer in English, based on the dialogue: 직원은 무엇이 문제라고 생각했어요?
answers: ① 저는 205호에 사는데 도어락에서 계속 소리가 나요. ② 지금 밖에 있는데 문을 열 수 없어요.
한 시간 기다렸는데 기사님이 안 와요.
The door lock battery is dead (배터리가 없어요).
